task_name: Relocate Town Hall and Water Tower to Free Residential Frontage and Upgrade Homes

when_to_do_it.trigger_condition: When non-boosting buildings (Town Hall, Basic Water Tower) occupy prime road frontage inside the park's coverage area, and Wood/Metal are ready for residential upgrades.
when_to_do_it.strategic_reasoning: Moving Town Hall and the Water Tower to secondary roads frees up space around the Small Fountain Park so additional residential buildings can be clustered inside the park's population-boosting radius.
preconditions: Wood and Metal ready at factories
when_to_do_it.placement_rule: Move Town Hall to the lower road and the Basic Water Tower to the northern industrial road, then upgrade the residential buildings near the park.

steps.who: Town Hall (tap and hold to pick up)
steps.briefing: move Town Hall to the lower-right road intersection and click the green checkmark.

steps.who: floating Wood on the first Small Factory
steps.briefing: collect finished Wood and drag Wood back into its production slot.

steps.who: yellow hard hat on the house next to Building Supplies Store
steps.briefing: drag Wood (2/1) onto the house to upgrade it.

steps.who: Small Fountain Park (tap and hold to adjust)
steps.briefing: shift the Small Fountain Park slightly left to cover the upgrading apartment building and click the green checkmark.

steps.who: Basic Water Tower (tap and hold to pick up)
steps.briefing: move the Basic Water Tower to the northern industrial road next to the Small Factories and click the green checkmark.

steps.who: floating Metal on the northern Small Factories
steps.briefing: collect finished Metal and re-queue Metal in both factories.

steps.who: yellow hard hat on the lower residential house
steps.briefing: drag Wood (1/1) and Metal (4/1) onto the house to upgrade it.
